description_en: Queries the task result of a local video upload node
description_zh: 查询本地录像上传任务结果
name: QueryLocalFileUploadJob

parameters.help_en:
The instance ID.

You can view the ID of the current instance on the Instance Overview page in the IoT Platform console. If an ID value exists, you must specify this ID value. Otherwise, the call fails.

If the public instance does not have an ID value, refer to https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/267533.html
parameters.help_zh:
实例ID。

您可在物联网平台控制台的实例概览页面，查看当前实例的ID。若有ID值，必须传入该ID值，否则调用会失败。

如果公共实例没有ID值，请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/267533.html
parameters.name: iot_instance_id

parameters.help_en: The ID of the local video upload task. Created by calling https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/363002.html
parameters.help_zh: 本地录像上传任务ID。通过https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/363002.html创建
parameters.name: job_id

Code.description_en:
The response code. Valid values:

200: Success.
Other values: Error codes. For more information, refer to [Error codes]（https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/145071.html）
Code.description_zh:
接口返回码：

200：表示成功。
其它：表示错误码。错误码详情，请参见[错误码]（https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/145071.html）

Code.description_en:
The status code of the video upload task. Valid values:

200: Normal.
9201: The device is offline. Bring the device online and try again.
9409: No cloud storage quota available. Check the cloud storage quota and try again.
9417: Device, network, or other exception. Try again, or check the device and network status.
9435: The video file does not exist. Make sure the video device has local video files, and then try again
Code.description_zh:
录像上传任务状态码：

200：正常。
9201 ：设备不在线。请上线设备后重试。
9409 ：无云存储配额。请检查云存储配额后重试。
9417：设备、网络或其它异常。请您重试，或检查设备和网络状态。
9435 ：录像文件不存在。请确保视频设备本地存证录像文件，然后重试

DeviceName.description_en: The name of the video device

FileEndTime.description_en: The end time of the video file

FileName.description_en: The name of the video file

FileStartTime.description_en: The start time of the video file

IotId.description_en: The device ID of the video device. This is the ID issued by IoT Platform for the device and serves as the unique identifier of the device
IotId.description_zh: 视频设备的设备ID。物联网平台为该设备颁发的ID，设备的唯一标识符

ProductKey.description_en: The ProductKey of the product to which the video device belongs

SlotEndTime.description_en: The end time of the video upload task
SlotEndTime.description_zh: 录像上传任务结束时间

SlotStartTime.description_en: The start time of the video upload task
SlotStartTime.description_zh: 录像上传任务开始时间

SlotStatus.description_en:
The execution status of the video upload task within the time period between SlotStartTime and SlotEndTime. Valid values:
0: The task is being initialized.
1: The task is being executed.
2: The task is completed.
3: The task encountered an exception.
4: The task was actively terminated
SlotStatus.description_zh:
SlotStartTime和SlotEndTime的时间段内，录像上传任务的执行状态：
0：任务初始化中。
1：任务执行中。
2：任务执行完成。
3：任务执行异常。
4：任务主动结束

Status.description_en:
The status of the video upload task. Valid values:

0: The task is being initialized.
1: The task is being executed.
2: The task is completed
Status.description_zh:
录像上传任务状态：

0：任务初始化中。
1：任务执行中。
2：任务执行完成

ErrorMessage.description_en: The error message returned if the call fails
ErrorMessage.description_zh: 调用失败时，返回的出错信息

RequestId.description_en: The unique identifier generated by Alibaba Cloud for the request
RequestId.description_zh: 阿里云为该请求生成的唯一标识符

Success.description_en:
Indicates whether the call was successful. Valid values:
true: The call was successful.
false: The call failed
Success.description_zh:
是否调用成功：
true：调用成功。
false：调用失败
